Name: Slime Egg Fix
Author: Kazooo
Description:
Fixes the slime eggs so they are all at the same height.

Has a config:
Position = down (default) : moves the green and tiger slime eggs down one pixel to match blue, red and purple slime eggs
Position = up : moves the blue, red and purple slime eggs up one pixel to match green and tiger slime

Downloads.Description: Fixes the slime eggs so they are all at the same height.
